function.description: Discover AnySite endpoints BEFORE calling anysite_api: pass search=<keyword> to list matching endpoint paths, then endpoint=<path> to read that endpoint's exact input params and output fields. Guessing paths wastes steps on Not Found and param-validation errors.
function.name: anysite_describe

endpoint.description: One endpoint to describe in full (input params + output fields), e.g. '/api/twitter/search/posts' or 'twitter.search.posts'.

search.description: Keyword to find endpoints, e.g. 'twitter', 'company', 'github'. Returns the matching paths only.
